_label: SYNTHETIC CASES authored for plan kensaku-v1-2 (EV-020). Event shapes follow the Stripe Event and Checkout Session objects documented for apiVersion 2026-10-28.endive (research/stripe-2026-11-23.md S28-S42). Not captured from a live Stripe delivery. Frozen at approval.

rules.delivery: The test posts each delivery to POST /api/stripe/webhook on the app built by createApp with a fake CheckoutPort and a temporary store. The body is JSON.stringify of the full event: { id, object: 'event', api_version: '2026-10-28.endive', created, livemode, type, data: { object } }, where created is the test clock's time in seconds. The Stripe-Signature header is made with stripe.webhooks.generateTestHeaderString({ payload, secret, timestamp }) using a secret the test builds at runtime (never a literal that looks like a real secret). signature: 'valid' signs with the right secret and the current time; 'wrong-secret' signs with another secret; 'stale' signs with a timestamp 400 seconds in the past (tolerance 300 s, S29); 'missing' sends no header; 'tampered' signs, then changes one byte of the body.
rules.verification: W-V1: signature invalid, stale, missing, or tampered -> 400 rejected-signature; no state change; the event id is not recorded as processed. W-V2: valid signature but body not a JSON event object -> 400 invalid-payload. W-V3: event.livemode === true or data.object.livemode === true -> 400 rejected-livemode, logged, no state change, not recorded.
rules.dedupe: W-D1: after verification, an event id already processed -> 200 duplicate and nothing else happens. Processed ids persist in the commerce store (kept 30 days, at most 10000, oldest dropped first).
rules.matching: W-M1: checkout.session.* events find the order by data.object.client_reference_id; payment_intent.payment_failed finds it by data.object.metadata.kensaku_order_id. No order -> 200 unknown-order. W-M2: for checkout.session.*, data.object.id must equal the order's stripeSessionId, and for checkout.session.completed and async_payment_succeeded also amount_total must equal the order's totalMinor and currency its lowercase currency; otherwise 200 mismatch, no state change, logged. Every 200 outcome records the event id as processed.
rules.transitions: States: open, paid, cancelled, expired, payment_failed, failed. checkout.session.completed with payment_status 'paid' -> paid from any state except paid; if the prior state was not open, record anomaly 'completed-after-<prior state>'. completed with payment_status 'unpaid' -> stays open with awaitingAsyncPayment true. completed with 'no_payment_required' -> no-transition, logged. checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded -> paid (same rules as completed paid). checkout.session.async_payment_failed -> payment_failed only from open. checkout.session.expired -> expired only from open; no-transition otherwise. payment_intent.payment_failed -> declinedAttempts + 1 only while open; no-transition otherwise. Any other type -> 200 ignored-type. Outcome 'applied' means the order or its declinedAttempts changed.
rules.cart: When an order becomes paid, the cart is cleared if and only if the cart's version still equals the order's cartVersion (the cart was not edited after checkout started).
rules.paidOnlyByWebhook: No code path other than a verified checkout.session.completed (paid) or checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded event sets state paid (D-047). The cancel and checkout routes never set paid.
rules.cancel: POST /api/orders/:id/cancel: open -> port.expireSession(sessionId); success -> cancelled (200); port error 'session-not-open' -> 409 already-completed, state unchanged; other port error -> 502, state unchanged. cancelled, expired, payment_failed, failed -> 200 unchanged, no port call. paid -> 409 already-paid, no port call. Unknown id -> 404.
rules.checkout: POST /api/checkout: checkout not configured -> 503 checkout-not-configured; empty cart -> 400 cart-empty; both without a port call. If another order is open, port.expireSession is called for it first and it becomes expired with reason superseded (if that expire fails with session-not-open, it stays open and the new checkout proceeds). Then a new order (state open, cartVersion = current cart version, stripeSessionId from the port) is created. Port create error, a session with livemode true, or (live port only) a url that does not start with https://checkout.stripe.com/ -> 502, the order is stored as failed, no url is returned, the cart is unchanged.

webhookCases.rationale: Paid by a verified completed event; cart cleared.
Cart edited after checkout started: paid, cart kept.
Duplicate delivery of the same event (at-least-once, S31).
Out of order: expired after completed does not undo paid (S30).
Session expired while open.
A verified payment wins even after an expired event; the anomaly is recorded.
Wrong secret is rejected and not recorded, so a later valid delivery of the same id still applies.
Timestamp outside tolerance.
No signature header.
Body changed after signing.
Live-mode event is refused (D-050).
Live-mode object inside a test-mode event is refused.
Unknown order reference.
Session id does not match the order's session.
Amount differs from the order total.
Currency differs from the order currency.
Completed but unpaid, then the async payment succeeds.
Completed but unpaid, then the async payment fails.
Declined attempts are counted while open; a duplicate is not counted twice.
A decline after cancellation changes nothing.
Unhandled event types are acknowledged and ignored.
Expired after the owner cancelled: stays cancelled.
no_payment_required is not expected for these orders.
Correctly signed body that is not an event object.

routeCases.rationale: Owner cancels an open order; the later expired event is a no-op.
Cancel races a completed payment: expire fails, the webhook then marks paid.
A paid order cannot be cancelled.
A new checkout supersedes the open order.
The port returns a live-mode session.
The live port refuses a checkout url that is not Stripe-hosted.
